First off- this app is incredible. And I really appreciate its affordability, please never change that! This app can do (almost) everything you need and want. With that in mind, here’s my biggest request/ suggestion I think would be amazing to add. 
— The ability to track any specific supplements. If I could input that I’m taking “Aloe” or enter any custom name vitamin as part of my GLP-1 health routines, and then select the days I take it or amount per day and just check a box that it’s been done, that would help me tremendously. Sometimes the brain fog makes it hard for me to keep up with my 2 electrolyte packets, my Pepcid, my aloe, and my Ovasitol. Maybe even Caffeine intake. reviews.title: Kudos to the Developer
reviews.text:
The fact that the developer is so responsive is what made me pick this one. I used it for almost 100 days free before paying the yearly price (in the end I decided it had been helpful enough to be worth sending the developers something, even if I didn't need the extra features).

I don't use the food charting as much as I should, but it's useful and easy to use when I do. 

The side effect tracking is excellent. You can even add your own options to track. 

The dose logs and tracking have helped me immensely, because I had been writing the time and date on the med box to keep track for family, but I had forgotten to do it a couple of times, so I was able to go back and fill in the spots I had missed so we have a full accounting of my doses in two places. 

Overall, this app serves my needs just how I like it, and I am pleased with everything.

If you are on a GLP-1 journey and struggling to stay consistent, track your nutrition, or simply manage all the details that come with treatment, this app can honestly become a game changer. I’ve been using it for over 300 days, every single day, and I can confidently say my progress would have been significantly harder without it.

What makes this app different is that it’s not just another weight-loss tracker. It helps you build structure and consistency around the things that actually matter during GLP-1 treatment: protein intake, hydration, calories, progress tracking, and even injection reminders. Instead of feeling overwhelmed trying to manage everything mentally, the app creates clarity and accountability in a very simple and practical way.

For anyone serious about succeeding with GLP-1 treatment, I genuinely recommend giving it a try.

reviews.title: Cutting Edge Scanning Feature 🤩 Missing Apple Health Data Write 😥
reviews.text:
This app does almost everything I want from a GLP-1 tracker, and does it very well. It of course has a medication tracker, nutrition tracker, and a water tracker all together with a helpful (read-only/local-only) nutrition tracker. The killer feature for me is that it can read scales and nutrition labels seamlessly. The only thing it doesn't do is write medication timestamps or any of that yummy nutrition data it generates out to Apple Health. For folks like me to want to use Apple Health as the center of their health world, that is a bit of a bummer.

Edit to add: I'm only on day 3 of my GLP-1 journey as I wrote this and I already feel so much more consistent and motivated thanks to this app bringing it all together with the nice polish (widgets, a mascot, and a beautiful UI). I would 10/10 personally recommend this to anyone starting or progressing through GLP-1 treatment. I just have to withhold the star for not being able to "do it all" *and* let Apple Health hold the data too.
